calls.title: Experiment Results Info UI
calls.summary: The team convened to strategize on improving the user interface (UI) concerning suspicious and draw statuses, deciding to enhance clarity through updated icons and popover text while avoiding overwhelming users. Kari Kay proposed consolidating scattered tooltips into a single list to streamline user guidance, with Luke Sonnet and Adriel Vieira emphasizing the need for context-specific alerts. They agreed to retain the current color schemes pending user research, and preferred minimal, concise badges for the 'draw' state. Popovers were refined to trigger from specific UI elements, providing users with relevant information. Notably, the term 'significant' was eliminated from popovers for clearer communication. The timeline for these changes targets a Monday release, with plans to hire a dedicated visualization expert for future enhancements.
calls.keywords: Results Page, Tooltip, Suspicious Change, Data Visualization, Confidence Interval, No Data State
